description: Ding, Yu and colleagues describe this resource in the native deposit. This benchmark contains a 600-record training set and a 10,000-record comparison set. Each has Rayleigh-distributed wind speed and simulated flapwise and edgewise bending moments in kN-m, excluding the serial-number field. TurbSim and FAST generated the load responses, according to the description. These are synthetic turbine-load observations for extreme-load model assessment, not field measurements. The source attributes the simulations to Eunshin Byon at the University of Michigan and does not identify all simulator settings. Zenodo provides the deposit with open access under cc-by-4.0. The native file inventory establishes deposited data, but values and linked file bodies were not read. Coverage is limited to the stated experiment, model or application; transfer to other turbines, sites or operating regimes requires separate assessment. Publication date alone does not establish current maintenance.
